theme: conjecture shot: Harappa seal legends against Vats's stratum order in Mound F (HARP 3B-1 to 3C-4), mound and label-source split, with a seal-format positive control
question: Did Harappa's seal legends keep one fixed pattern (closing stock, opening and closing signs, variants, length, sign inventory) from the end of Period 3B to the end of 3C while the seal changed form, testing on period-labelled Harappa seals outside Vats's Mound F and confirming once on the 175 Mound F seals with a Vats stratum, permuted within trenches?
outcome: Discovery, 99 period-labelled seals in seven frames outside Mound F's stratified seals: union closing stock (DK-G 12 signs plus Harappa 405, 154, 595) closes 0.71 early and 0.73 late; no drift test reaches p 0.05 (openings 0.56, closings 0.59, length 0.51, inventory 0.82, variants 0.084); rectangular seals 0.09 to 0.29 (p 0.015). Credence 0.35 to 0.40 before the freeze. Confirmation, 173 Mound F seals in six trench frames, one read 21 s after the hashed freeze: P1 pass (stock share late minus early -0.044, 0.848 to 0.805, 90% interval -0.190 to 0.102), P2 pass (0.848), P3 no drift (openings z 0.09, p 0.39), P4 drift (variants z 5.94, p 0.0001, Holm 0.0006), P5 drift (length r 0.273, two-sided p 0.003, Holm 0.012; 4.04, 4.77, 5.31 signs by third), P6 drift (inventory z 3.73, p 0.0016, Holm 0.008), P7 no drift (closings p 0.70), PC pass (rectangular r 0.230, p 0.0017). Drift with Holm p below 0.05 in P4-P6 kills C-0010 at 0.02 (effects alone 0.32). Whole-mound permutation, depth clock, DK-G stock alone and complete legends alone give the same outcomes; variant drift depends on Trench I (p 0.16 without it). Independent script reproduces population, shares, length r 0.2725 (p 0.0032) and inventory 42.52 (p 0.0012). Post-outcome (exploratory): drift holds with format fixed (0.0005, 0.0029, 0.0052) and on square seals alone (0.0006, 0.009, 0.037); interior signs 2.0, 2.9, 3.3; 806 (0/4/8 legends by third), 817 (0/7/7), 233 (1/5/8) arrive, 390 (7/3/2) and 741 fade; interior signs become less Mohenjo-daro-like (r -0.25, p 0.004).
challenge: HARP's own seals in the export are too few for a within-mound test (36 with a period label), so the clock is Vats's stratum order in Mound F, mapped to HARP periods by the export from an undocumented source; Vats's strata follow depth and he misdated tablets in Trench I. The early third is mostly Strata VI and V (3B/C), with two Stratum VII seals. The census printed Mound F object types by stratum before the design, so the positive control was not blind, and the within-trench format test has low power (0.38 for a 10% to 25% rise). Many legends are broken; positions are read at surviving edges. The variant and inventory drifts share signs (806, 817, 390) and are not independent evidence. Corpus-wide closing structure, Harappa 3B-3C sign frequencies, and motif and size by Harappa period were examined by earlier packages.
remedy: Mound-and-label-source split with the loader given the Mound F file alone and both halves read after the freeze, package ledger copied from bench/spent.json; stratum mid-rank over the mound with permutations within Vats's trenches; three-outcome drift tests so a fixity claim can lose, single-deletion influence rules and Holm over six tests for the kill; within-frame permutation (not bootstrap) for the P1 fail side after the bootstrap rule failed 7.7% of null populations; planted-effect power on Mound F-shaped populations with 25% and 50% stratum mixing; half-weight gains when the positive control fails; two scratchpad dry runs of the loader path; sensitivity analyses for whole-mound permutation, depth clock, DK-G stock, complete legends and loader halves; independent recomputation after the read.
retry_when: Seals with an independent clock outside the Lipi export, above all HARP's Period 3A-3C seals in CISI 3.1 (Q-1008), scored with the three predictions frozen at the end of REPORT.md (closing-stock share within 0.25, more interior signs in 3C, 806 and 817 at most 3% of 3A-3B and at least 8% of 3C legends); or Vats's 471 stratified non-seal faces from Mound F for the same body-growth question on tablets. Do not retest legends against period on Vats's Mound F stratified seals, which are spent for harappa_period_sequence.
